dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product may set display text, running text and code in different families, draws its icons from one icon font, and uses a few named weights.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: The font stacks and weights the type scale is built from. Components never reference these; they use sys.typescale roles.
rules: Re-point a stack in a layer to change the typeface everywhere.
Fonts are referenced by name and are not bundled: make sure the product ships or loads them.
`icon` is the icon font; draw an icon with sys.icon.weight and sys.icon.fill — never with a text weight.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A font family is a choice, not a quantity.

brand.$description: Display and headline text. Inter for Latin, Noto Sans JP for Japanese, Noto Sans for other scripts; a product adds the Noto family of each further script it ships (Noto Sans KR, SC, TC, Arabic, Devanagari, Thai…).

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A font family is a choice, not a quantity.

plain.$description: Running text and labels. Inter for Latin, Noto Sans JP for Japanese, Noto Sans for other scripts.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A font family is a choice, not a quantity.

mono.$description: Code. Roboto Mono, with Noto Sans JP for Japanese inside code.

icon.$description: The icon font. Material Symbols Rounded: a variable font whose weight and fill are set from sys.icon.
